title: 第13章 从未见过如此强大的存在第14章 姨养你一辈子
slug: 无敌的女厉鬼有点恋爱脑
lines: 多……多少星？！
陆远的大脑一片空白，几乎以为是两脚羊那一下，把自己砸出了幻觉。
陆远强撑着涣散的意识，重新数了一遍。
一，二，三……
整整十颗满星！
这意味着……
二十星的危险级别！
陆远不知道该怎么形容这个危险级别。
反正，陆远跟危险级别八星的两脚羊战斗，结果已经非常明显了，陆远完全不是两脚羊的对手。
在这八星两脚羊手中，陆远甚至连一分钟都没坚持下来，便被砸得动弹不得，濒临死亡。
二……二十星？！
陆远完全想象不到危险级别二十星，这究竟是多么夸张恐怖的实力。
另外……
顾……顾清婉？？！
这个名字，怎么好像有点熟悉，也不知道是在哪儿听过，或者看过……
陆远努力回想，却只觉脑袋里一片浆糊，头痛欲裂。
就在陆远陷入无边震惊时，四面八方的血海已汇聚于他身前。
浓郁刺鼻的血腥味，几乎凝成了实质，堵住了陆远的口鼻，让他呼吸困难。
最终，一道倩影在血海中缓缓凝聚成形。
陆远看不清她的全貌。
只看到一个芊芊窈窕的轮廓，身高约莫一米七出头。
她身着一袭嫁衣，那红色鲜活得像是流动的血液。
头顶，一块鎏金红盖头垂下，遮蔽了所有窥探，也隔绝了她的真容。
陆远看不到她的脸。
只能从衣袂的缝隙间，瞥见那一抹惊心动魄的雪白肌肤，在血色与月光的映衬下，显得愈发苍白。
鬼新娘现身了……
而那头刚刚还凶性滔天，将陆远逼入绝境的人面两脚羊，此刻竟被无形的恐惧扼住了喉咙。
它只看了鬼新娘一眼，便像是见了世间最恐怖的天敌，四蹄一转，就要朝反方向夺路狂奔！
只不过，这鬼新娘只是轻轻一抬那白皙又尖锐的玉手。
刹那间，血海滔天而起，化作四面血墙，将这片天地彻底囚禁。
血墙高耸入云，隔绝了所有逃生的可能，仿佛连空气都被凝固。
两脚羊跑不掉了。
它绝望地回身，那只独眼中流淌出近乎凝成实质的恐惧，身体止不住地颤抖。
content_en:
How many stars? !
Lu Yuan's mind went blank, and he almost thought it was a two-legged sheep that knocked him out of the hallucination.
Lu Yuanqiang held on to his scattered consciousness and counted again.
One, two, three...
A total of ten full stars!
This means...
Twenty-star danger level!
Lu Yuan didn't know how to describe this level of danger.
Anyway, the result of Lu Yuan's battle with the eight-star dangerous two-legged sheep was already very obvious. Lu Yuan was no match for the two-legged sheep.
In the hands of this eight-star two-legged sheep, Lu Yuan couldn't even hold on for a minute before he was beaten to the point of being unable to move and on the verge of death.
Two...twenty stars? !
Lu Yuan could not imagine at all how exaggerated and terrifying the strength of the dangerous level twenty stars was.
Also…
Gu...Gu Qingwan? ? !
This name seems a bit familiar. I don’t know where I have heard it or seen it...
Lu Yuan tried hard to recall, but all he felt was that his head was filled with mush and he had a splitting headache.
Just when Lu Yuan was in boundless shock, the sea of ​​blood from all directions had gathered in front of him.
The strong and pungent smell of blood almost condensed into substance, blocking Lu Yuan's mouth and nose, making it difficult for him to breathe.
In the end, a beautiful shadow slowly condensed into shape in the sea of ​​blood.
Lu Yuan couldn't see her whole picture clearly.
All I saw was a slim silhouette, about a little over 1.7 meters tall.
She was wearing a wedding dress, and the red color was as vivid as flowing blood.
Above her head, a gilded red hijab hangs down, blocking all prying eyes and isolating her true appearance.
Lu Yuan couldn't see her face.
Only through the gaps in her clothes could she catch a glimpse of the thrilling snow-white skin, which looked even paler against the backdrop of blood and moonlight.
The ghost bride appears...
And the sheep with a human face and two legs, who had been so ferocious just now and forced Lu Yuan into a desperate situation, was now choked by invisible fear.
It only glanced at the Ghost Bride, and as if it had seen the most terrifying natural enemy in the world, it turned its hooves and was about to run in the opposite direction!
However, the ghost bride just gently raised her white and sharp jade hands.
In an instant, the sea of ​​​​blood rose into the sky and turned into four walls of blood, completely imprisoning the world.
The blood wall towered into the clouds, cutting off all possibilities of escape, as if even the air was frozen.
The two-legged sheep can't run away.
It turned back in despair, fear that was almost solidified flowing out of its one eye, and its body could not stop shaking.
